name: Streampixel
what_it_is: A pixel streaming service for Unreal Engine applications that runs packaged builds on RTX GPUs and delivers them in the browser through a share link.
platforms: Browser delivery of Unreal Engine builds
pricing: A flat EUR 99 per month with unlimited streaming minutes and 2 concurrent users included; extra concurrent capacity is EUR 45 per month per concurrent user. A 2-day free trial needs no credit card.
notable: Runs on RTX 6000 Ada GPUs in its own data centers, according to the vendor

facts.fact: Streampixel runs Unreal Engine applications in the browser on RTX GPUs; users upload a packaged build or .exe and get a share link.
Pricing is a flat EUR 99 per month with unlimited minutes and 2 concurrent users; additional concurrent capacity costs EUR 45 per month per CCU.
Included features list 4K streaming, a source control connection for CI/CD, custom splash screens, security controls, analytics and built-in voice, video and text chat.
The vendor says machines use RTX 6000 Ada GPUs and operates its stack from its own data centers; the footer names Vardexa OÜ.
